 Some moments are for hustle and heavy focus, while others are for flow and relaxed effort. And Rewind supports your body no matter which work moment you’re in! With adjustable footrest, headrest, armrests, recliner, and dynamic lumbar support, it’s a desk chair re-shapes itself for each moment  
 Now, Put Your Feet Up! This 360 Deg swivel chair features a manually retractable leg rest that can be used while seated or reclining. So whether it’s time to refocus, time to change leg position, or time for a nap, The Rewind Ergonomic Chair lets you do it your way, and in a comfy space saving way.  
 Adjustable and Responsive: The adjustable headrest moves up and down and tilts for optimized head comfort while 3-Directional Armrests slide forwards, back, up, down, and rotate for maximal support. Dynamic Lumbar Support responds naturally to your position, so your mind is free to focus with ease. The height adjusts from 18.3 – 21.3” (seat to floor) with a hip width of 19.7” and 275lb capacity.  
 Smooth, Silent, Secure: With smooth “rollerblade” Pro Wheels, 2:1 Synchronized Weight Sensing Multifunctional Line Mechanism and Recline Lock, Rewind is not just a stable comfortable chair, but offers the same silent satisfaction as an EV. This mesh office chair is also cooling but without the unforgiving feeling of sitting on wire!  
 Minimal Assembly: The Rewind, desk and gaming chair comes pre-assembled, you just need to finish it off (tools and instructions included). Available in neutral gray, navy, black and fun mint green or orange, order the Nouhaus Rewind you love most, and pop your feet up for the rest of the day.
